to deny people their rights

teaching.description: In the midst of the tragic demise of old Jerusalem, Jeremiah reminds us of God's great faithfulness and mercies that are new every morning.

teaching.description: In the midst of the tragic demise of old Jerusalem, Jeremiah reminds us of God's great faithfulness and mercies that are new every morning.

teaching.description: In the midst of the tragic demise of old Jerusalem, Jeremiah reminds us of God's great faithfulness and mercies that are new every morning.

teaching.description: In the midst of the tragic demise of old Jerusalem, Jeremiah reminds us of God's great faithfulness and mercies that are new every morning.

teaching.description: In the midst of the tragic demise of old Jerusalem, Jeremiah reminds us of God's great faithfulness and mercies that are new every morning.

teaching.description: In the midst of the tragic demise of old Jerusalem, Jeremiah reminds us of God's great faithfulness and mercies that are new every morning.

for Mount Zion, which lies desolate,
